text: That afternoon: Holmes sketches out for Miss Stoner what occurred in the morning, and she turns white
why: ¶126-127 show Holmes arriving in the afternoon, sketching out the morning's events to Miss Stoner, and her turning white to the lips.
¶127 says Holmes sketched out what had occurred, and the morning's events (the visit to Baker Street, Roylott's confrontation, the poker) are narrated in ¶95-113.
